healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Get the authenticated Clockify user via GET /user. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_CURRENTLY_LOGGED_IN_USER_INFO.

include-memberships.description: If true, include workspace memberships on the user.

workspaces.list.title: List Workspaces
workspaces.list.description: List accessible Clockify workspaces. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES.

roles.description: Optional workspace roles filter accepted by Clockify.

projects.list.title: List Projects
projects.list.description: List projects in a workspace. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_PROJECTS.

tasks.list.title: List Tasks
tasks.list.description: List tasks in a Clockify project. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_TASKS.

user_groups.users.add.title: Add User to Group
user_groups.users.add.description: Tool to add a user to a user group in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to add a specific user to an existing group. Covers CLOCKIFY_ADD_USER_TO_GROUP.

userId.description: Represents user identifier to add to the group.

userGroupId.description: Represents user group identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents workspace identifier across the system.

clients.create.title: Create Client
clients.create.description: Tool to add a new client to a workspace. Use when you need to create a client in a specific workspace. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_CLIENT.

note.description: Represents additional notes for the client (0..3000 characters).

workspaceId.description: Represents workspace identifier across the system.

projects.create.title: Create New Project
projects.create.description: Tool to create a new project in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to create a project with name, color, billable status, visibility, and optional client association. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_NEW_PROJECT.

note.description: Additional notes for the project (0..3000 characters).

public.description: Project visibility - true for public, false for private.

billable.description: Whether the project is billable. Defaults to false if not provided.

clientId.description: ID of the client associated with the project.

estimate.description: Time estimate settings for the project.

hourlyRate.description: Hourly rate for the project containing amount and currency.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID where the project will be created.

shared_reports.create.title: Create Shared Report
shared_reports.create.description: Tool to create a shared report in Clockify. Use when generating shareable summary, detailed, or weekly reports with custom date ranges and grouping options. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_SHARED_REPORT.

filter.description: Filter configuration for the report including date ranges and grouping.

isPublic.description: Whether the report is publicly accessible.

fixedDate.description: Whether the date range is fixed or dynamic.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier where the shared report will be created.

tags.create.title: Create Tag
tags.create.description: Create a named tag in a Clockify workspace. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_TAG.

name.description: Optional tag name (0-100 characters). Omit to use Clockify's default empty name.

workspaceId.description: ID of the workspace in which to create the tag.

tasks.create.title: Create Task
tasks.create.description: Tool to add a new task to a project in Clockify. Use when you need to create a task with optional time estimates, assignees, and billable status. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_TASK.

name.description: Name of the task to create.

billable.description: Whether the task is billable. Defaults to project settings if not provided.

estimate.description: Time estimate in ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., PT2H30M for 2 hours 30 minutes).

projectId.description: Project identifier where the task will be created.

assigneeIds.description: Array of user IDs to assign to the task.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier where the project exists.

templates.create.title: Create Templates On Workspace
templates.create.description: Tool to create templates on a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to create one or more templates with associated projects and tasks for reusable project structures. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_TEMPLATES_ON_WORKSPACE.

templates.description: List of templates to create on the workspace. Each template requires a name and at least one project.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

time_entries.create.title: Create Time Entry
time_entries.create.description: Tool to create a new time entry in a Clockify workspace. Use when logging time with start/end timestamps, project/task/tag associations, and billable status. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_TIME_ENTRY.

end.description: End time in ISO 8601 format. If omitted, timer will be running.

tagIds.description: List of tag IDs to associate with this time entry.

taskId.description: ID of the task this time entry is associated with.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable. Defaults to project settings if not provided.

projectId.description: ID of the project this time entry belongs to.

description.description: Description of the work done (0..3000 characters).

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier where the time entry will be created.

customFieldValues.description: List of custom field values for this time entry.

user_groups.create.title: Create User Group
user_groups.create.description: Tool to create a new user group in a workspace. Use when you need to add a group to organize users within a specific workspace. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_USER_GROUP.

name.description: Represents a user group name (0..100 characters).

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

time_entries.create_for_user.title: Create User Time Entry
time_entries.create_for_user.description: Tool to create a time entry for another user in a Clockify workspace. Use when adding time logs on behalf of team members with admin/manager permissions. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_USER_TIME_ENTRY.

end.description: End time in ISO 8601 format. If omitted, creates a running timer.

tagIds.description: List of tag IDs to associate with this time entry.

taskId.description: ID of the task this time entry is associated with.

userId.description: User identifier for whom the time entry is being created.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable. Defaults to project settings if not provided.

projectId.description: ID of the project this time entry belongs to.

from-entry.description: Time entry identifier to copy from.

description.description: Description of the work done (max 3000 characters).

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier where the time entry will be created.

customFields.description: List of custom field values (max 50 items).

webhooks.create.title: Create Webhook
webhooks.create.description: Tool to create a new webhook in a workspace. Use when you want to subscribe to workspace events by registering a callback URL. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_WEBHOOK.

workspaceId.description: Represents workspace identifier across the system.

triggerSource.description: List of resource IDs that will trigger the webhook. Must match the type specified in trigger_source_type (e.g., workspace IDs for WORKSPACE_ID, user IDs for USER_ID).

workspaces.create.title: Create Workspace
workspaces.create.description: Tool to create a new workspace in Clockify. Use when you need to set up a new workspace for time tracking and project management. Covers CLOCKIFY_CREATE_WORKSPACE.

organizationId.description: Cake organization identifier. Optional parameter to associate workspace with an organization.

clients.delete.title: Delete Client
clients.delete.description: Permanently deletes a client from a Clockify workspace. Returns the deleted client's data. Warning: This action is irreversible. Ensure the client has no associated projects or time entries. Covers CLOCKIFY_DELETE_CLIENT.

clientId.description: The unique identifier of the client to delete.

workspaceId.description: The unique identifier of the workspace containing the client.

projects.delete.title: Delete Project
projects.delete.description: Tool to delete a project from a workspace. Use when you need to permanently remove a project. Warning: This action is irreversible and may affect associated time entries and tasks. Covers CLOCKIFY_DELETE_PROJECT.

projectId.description: Represents a project identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

shared_reports.delete.title: Delete Shared Report
shared_reports.delete.description: Tool to delete a shared report from a workspace by ID. Use when you need to remove a shared report that is no longer needed. Covers CLOCKIFY_DELETE_SHARED_REPORT.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier containing the shared report.

tags.delete.title: Delete Tag
tags.delete.description: Tool to delete a tag from a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to remove an existing tag by its ID. Covers CLOCKIFY_DELETE_TAG.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier containing the tag.

tasks.delete.title: Delete Task
tasks.delete.description: Tool to delete a task from a project in Clockify. Use when removing tasks that are no longer needed or were created by mistake. Covers CLOCKIFY_DELETE_TASK.

taskId.description: Represents a task identifier across the system.

projectId.description: Represents a project identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

templates.delete.title: Delete Template
templates.delete.description: Tool to delete a template from a Clockify workspace. Returns the deleted template's data including entries, projects, and tasks. Covers CLOCKIFY_DELETE_TEMPLATE.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier containing the template.

time_entries.delete.title: Delete Time Entry
time_entries.delete.description: Tool to delete a time entry from a workspace by ID. Use for cleanup workflows such as removing bad imports, duplicates, or cancelled entries. Covers CLOCKIFY_DELETE_TIME_ENTRY.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier containing the time entry.

user_groups.delete.title: Delete User Group
user_groups.delete.description: Tool to delete a user group from a workspace. Use when you need to remove an existing user group by its ID. Covers CLOCKIFY_DELETE_USER_GROUP.

id.description: Represents a user group identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

time_entries.delete_for_user.title: Delete User Time Entries
time_entries.delete_for_user.description: Tool to delete multiple time entries for a user in a workspace. Use for bulk cleanup such as removing test data, correcting erroneous imports, or batch deleting cancelled work periods. Covers CLOCKIFY_DELETE_USER_TIME_ENTRIES.

userId.description: User identifier whose time entries will be deleted.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier containing the time entries to delete.

time-entry-ids.description: List of time entry identifiers to delete. At least one ID must be provided.

webhooks.delete.title: Delete Webhook
webhooks.delete.description: Tool to delete a webhook from a workspace. Use when you need to remove an existing webhook by its ID. Covers CLOCKIFY_DELETE_WEBHOOK.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier containing the webhook.

time_entries.duplicate.title: Duplicate Time Entry
time_entries.duplicate.description: Tool to duplicate an existing time entry in a Clockify workspace. Use when creating a copy of a time entry with the same attributes (project, task, tags, description, billable status). Covers CLOCKIFY_DUPLICATE_TIME_ENTRY.

userId.description: User identifier who owns the time entry.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier containing the time entry.

users.filter.title: Filter Workspace Users
users.filter.description: Tool to filter users in a workspace by advanced criteria. Use when you need a paginated, sortable list of workspace users matching multiple filters. Covers CLOCKIFY_FILTER_WORKSPACE_USERS.

name.description: Filter users by substring match in name (case-insensitive).

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1.

email.description: Filter users by substring match in email address (case-insensitive).

roles.description: Filter to only users having any of these roles.

pageSize.description: Number of users to return per page (1 to 5000).

projectId.description: Filter to only users who have access to this specific project ID.

userGroups.description: Filter to only users belonging to these user group IDs.

workspaceId.description: The unique identifier of the workspace to filter users from. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES to retrieve available workspace IDs.

includeRoles.description: When true, includes detailed role information (e.g., WORKSPACE_ADMIN, OWNER) in the response.

accountStatuses.description: Filter users by account status values.

users.managers.list.title: Find User's Team Managers
users.managers.list.description: Retrieves the list of team managers assigned to a specific user in a Clockify workspace. Team managers are users who have supervisory responsibilities over other users. Use this after obtaining valid workspace and user IDs from other actions. Covers CLOCKIFY_FIND_USER_TEAM_MANAGER.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1. Default: 1.

userId.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the user whose managers you want to find. Obtain this from the 'Find All Users On Workspace' action.

page-size.description: Number of managers to return per page (1-5000). Default: 50.

workspaceId.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the workspace. Obtain this from the 'Get All My Workspaces' action.

reports.detailed.title: Generate Detailed Report
reports.detailed.description: Tool to generate a detailed time entry report with filtering and pagination. Use when you need comprehensive time tracking data with project, client, user, and tag breakdowns for reporting or analysis. Covers CLOCKIFY_GENERATE_DETAILED_REPORT.

tags.description: Filter time entries by tag IDs and whether they are contained in the time entry.

users.description: Filter time entries by user IDs, contains operator, and status.

clients.description: Filter time entries by client IDs, contains operator, and status.

projects.description: Filter time entries by project IDs, contains operator, and status.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier to generate the report for. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES to get workspace IDs.

detailedFilter.description: Pagination settings for the report. Required for detailed reports.

reports.expenses.title: Generate Expense Report
reports.expenses.description: Tool to generate a detailed expense report for a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to retrieve and analyze expense data within a specific date range for reporting, invoicing, or financial analysis. Covers CLOCKIFY_GENERATE_EXPENSE_REPORT.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier (UUID) to generate the expense report for.

dateRangeEnd.description: End date in ISO 8601 format with milliseconds (e.g., '2026-02-13T23:59:59.999Z'). Defines the end of the expense reporting period.

dateRangeStart.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format with milliseconds (e.g., '2026-01-14T00:00:00.000Z'). Defines the beginning of the expense reporting period.

detailedFilter.description: Pagination configuration for detailed expense report.

webhooks.token.generate.title: Generate New Webhook Token
webhooks.token.generate.description: Tool to generate a new webhook token. Use after confirming workspace and webhook IDs. Covers CLOCKIFY_GENERATE_NEW_WEBHOOK_TOKEN.

reports.summary.title: Generate Summary Report
reports.summary.description: Tool to generate a summary report for time entries in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need aggregated time tracking data grouped by projects, users, clients, or other criteria for high-level analysis and reporting. Covers CLOCKIFY_GENERATE_SUMMARY_REPORT.

rounding.description: Whether to round time values in the report. If true, time entries will be rounded according to workspace settings.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier (UUID) to generate the summary report for.

dateRangeEnd.description: End date in ISO format with milliseconds (e.g., '2024-12-31T23:59:59.999'). Defines the end of the reporting period.

summaryFilter.description: Filter object specifying how to group the summary data (e.g., by project, user, client).

dateRangeStart.description: Start date in ISO format with milliseconds (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00.000'). Defines the beginning of the reporting period.

reports.weekly.title: Generate Weekly Report
reports.weekly.description: Tool to generate a weekly time entry report for a workspace with grouped data. Use when you need detailed weekly breakdowns of time entries organized by user, project, task, or other dimensions. Covers CLOCKIFY_GENERATE_WEEKLY_REPORT.

workspaceId.description: The workspace ID to generate the report for.

weeklyFilter.description: Filter object with group and subgroup properties for organizing the report.

webhooks.addons.list.title: Get All Addon Webhooks
webhooks.addons.list.description: Tool to list all webhooks for an addon in a workspace. Use after confirming workspace and addon IDs. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_ADDON_WEBHOOKS.

addonId.description: Represents addon identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents workspace identifier across the system.

webhooks.list.title: Get All Webhooks
webhooks.list.description: Tool to list all webhooks in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve defined webhooks after confirming the workspace ID. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_WEBHOOKS.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier (UUID) to list webhooks for.

clients.get.title: Get Client By ID
clients.get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific client in a Clockify workspace. Returns client details including name, contact information (email, address), billing currency, and archived status. Use 'Get All My Workspaces' to obtain workspace_id and 'Get Clients' to obtain client_id before calling this action. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_CLIENT_BY_ID.

clientId.description: The unique identifier of the client to retrieve. Can be obtained from the 'Get Clients' action.

workspaceId.description: The unique identifier of the workspace containing the client. Can be obtained from the 'Get All My Workspaces' action.

clients.list.title: Get Clients
clients.list.description: Tool to list clients in a workspace. Use after obtaining a workspace ID. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_CLIENTS.

name.description: Filter clients by name (case-insensitive partial match). Returns clients whose name contains the specified string.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Defaults to 1 if not specified.

page-size.description: Number of clients to return per page. Defaults to 50 if not specified.

workspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace to retrieve clients from. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES to get workspace IDs.

entities.created.title: Get Created Entities
entities.created.description: Tool to retrieve created entities within a workspace (Experimental). Use when you need to track incremental changes or newly created time entries, projects, clients, or other entity types. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_CREATED_ENTITIES.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Defaults to 1 if not specified.

page-size.description: Number of entities to return per page. Defaults to 50 if not specified.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier (UUID) to retrieve created entities from.

limit.description: Clockify entity-change page size (alias of page-size).

entities.deleted.title: Get Deleted Entities
entities.deleted.description: Tool to retrieve information about entities deleted within a date range (Experimental API). Use when you need to track incremental changes or identify deleted records for synchronization purposes. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_DELETED_ENTITIES.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Defaults to 1 if not specified.

endDate.description: Filter deleted entities up to this date/time (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z'). If not specified, retrieves up to current time.

page-size.description: Number of entities to return per page. Defaults to 50 if not specified.

startDate.description: Filter deleted entities from this date/time onwards (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'). If not specified, retrieves all deletions.

workspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace to retrieve deleted entities from. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES to get workspace IDs.

holidays.list.title: Get Holidays
holidays.list.description: Tool to retrieve all holidays for a workspace. Use when you need to list or filter workspace holidays after confirming the workspace ID. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_HOLIDAYS.

end.description: Optional end date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter holidays up to.

start.description: Optional start date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter holidays from.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier to retrieve holidays from.

holidays.in_period.title: Get Holidays In Period
holidays.in_period.description: Tool to retrieve holidays in a specific period. Use when you need holidays assigned to a user between two dates after confirming the workspace ID. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_HOLIDAYS_IN_PERIOD.

end.description: End datetime in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2022-12-31T23:59:59.999Z') to filter holidays up to. Must be after start.

start.description: Start datetime in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2022-12-01T00:00:00.000Z') to filter holidays from.

assigned-to.description: User ID to filter holidays assigned to.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier to retrieve holidays from.

time_entries.in_progress.title: Get In Progress Time Entries
time_entries.in_progress.description: Tool to retrieve all currently running time entries in a workspace. Use when you need to check which timers are active or see who is currently tracking time. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_IN_PROGRESS_TIME_ENTRIES.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Defaults to 1 if not specified.

page-size.description: Number of time entries to return per page. Defaults to 50 if not specified.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier (UUID) to retrieve in-progress time entries from.

users.profile.get.title: Get member's profile
users.profile.get.description: Tool to get a member's profile in a workspace. Use when you need detailed profile info after identifying the workspace and user. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_MEMBER_PROFILE.

userId.description: Identifier of the user whose profile is retrieved

workspaceId.description: Identifier of the workspace to which the user belongs

projects.get.title: Get Project
projects.get.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific project by ID. Use when you need to get project details such as name, billable status, budget estimates, rates, and memberships. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_PROJECT.

hydrated.description: If set to true, results will contain additional information about the project.

projectId.description: Represents a project identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system. Can be obtained from 'Get All My Workspaces' action.

expense-date.description: If provided, you will get expenses dated before the provided value in yyyy-MM-dd format.

expense-limit.description: Represents the maximum number of expenses to fetch.

custom-field-entity-type.description: If provided, you'll get a filtered list of custom fields that matches the provided string with the custom field entity type.

shared_reports.get.title: Get Shared Report
shared_reports.get.description: Tool to retrieve a shared report by ID from Clockify. Returns report data including totals, charts, groupings, and filter configuration. Use when you need to access and analyze shared report data. Note: This endpoint uses the Reports API domain (reports.api.clockify.me). Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_SHARED_REPORT.

id.description: The unique identifier of the shared report to retrieve. Example: 698f300e5c0941776aad095e

shared_reports.list.title: Get Shared Reports
shared_reports.list.description: Tool to retrieve all shared reports in a workspace. Use when you need to view reports that have been shared within the workspace. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_SHARED_REPORTS.

workspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace to retrieve shared reports from. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES to get workspace IDs.

tags.get.title: Get Tag By ID
tags.get.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific tag by ID in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to get tag details including name, workspace ID, and archived status. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_TAG.

id.description: Represents a tag identifier across the system. The unique ID of the tag to retrieve.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system. Get this from CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES.

tags.list.title: Get Tags
tags.list.description: Tool to find and list tags in a workspace. Use when you need to view all tags or filter tags by name or archived status. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_TAGS.

name.description: Filter tags by name (case-sensitive partial match). Returns tags whose name contains the specified string.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Defaults to 1 if not specified.

archived.description: Filter tags by archived status. If true, returns only archived tags. If false, returns only active tags.

page-size.description: Number of tags to return per page. Defaults to 50 if not specified.

workspaceId.description: ID of the workspace to retrieve tags from. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES to get workspace IDs.

tasks.get.title: Get Task
tasks.get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific task in a Clockify project. Returns task details including name, assignees, estimates, billable status, and rates. Use this to inspect or verify task information within a project. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_TASK.

taskId.description: The unique identifier of the task to retrieve.

projectId.description: The unique identifier of the project containing the task.

workspaceId.description: The unique identifier of the workspace containing the task. Get this from CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES.

templates.get.title: Get Template By ID On Workspace
templates.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific template by ID from a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to fetch template details including projects and tasks, optionally hydrated or cleansed. Note: This endpoint is deprecated in the API but remains functional. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_TEMPLATE_BY_ID_ON_WORKSPACE.

cleansed.description: If set to true will filter out inactive template projects and tasks.

hydrated.description: If set to true will return hydrated template projects and tasks.

templateId.description: Represents a template identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system. Can be obtained from the 'Get All My Workspaces' action.

templates.list.title: Get Templates On Workspace
templates.list.description: Tool to list all templates in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve available templates for creating projects or time entries. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_TEMPLATES_ON_WORKSPACE.

name.description: Filter templates by name (partial match). Returns templates that contain the provided string in their name.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Default is 1.

cleansed.description: If true, filters out inactive template projects and tasks. Default is false.

hydrated.description: If true, returns hydrated template projects and tasks with full object details. Default is false.

page-size.description: Number of templates to return per page. Default is 50.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier to retrieve templates from. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES to get workspace IDs.

time_entries.list.title: Get Time Entries
time_entries.list.description: Tool to retrieve historical time entries for a user in a workspace with filters. Use when you need to audit, summarize, or analyze time logs for reporting or invoicing. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_TIME_ENTRIES.

end.description: Filter time entries by end date/time (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z').

tags.description: Filter time entries by comma-separated tag IDs.

task.description: Filter time entries by task ID.

start.description: Filter time entries by start date/time (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z').

userId.description: User identifier (UUID) to retrieve time entries for.

project.description: Filter time entries by project ID.

hydrated.description: If true, project, task, and tags will be returned as full objects instead of just IDs.

page-size.description: Number of time entries per page (default: 50).

description.description: Filter time entries by description text (partial match supported).

in-progress.description: If true, returns only the currently running time entry (ignores other filters).

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier (UUID) to retrieve time entries from.

time_entries.get.title: Get Time Entry
time_entries.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific time entry by ID from a workspace. Use when you need to inspect details of a particular time entry for auditing, reporting, or further processing. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_TIME_ENTRY.

hydrated.description: If true, includes additional information such as full project, task, and tag objects instead of just IDs.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier containing the time entry.

entities.updated.title: Get Updated Entities
entities.updated.description: Tool to retrieve entities that have been updated in a workspace (Experimental). Use when tracking incremental changes to time entries, expenses, custom fields, or other entity types for synchronization or audit purposes. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_UPDATED_ENTITIES.

workspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace to query for updated entities. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES to get workspace IDs.

user_groups.list.title: Get User Groups
user_groups.list.description: Tool to find all user groups in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve all groups that organize users within a specific workspace. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_USER_GROUPS.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Defaults to 1 if not specified.

page-size.description: Number of user groups to return per page. Defaults to 50 if not specified.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

webhooks.get.title: Get Webhook By ID
webhooks.get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific webhook in a Clockify workspace. Returns the webhook's name, URL, event type, trigger source configuration, auth token, and enabled status. Use this to inspect or verify webhook settings. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_WEBHOOK_BY_ID.

webhookId.description: The unique ID of the webhook to retrieve. Get this from CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_WEBHOOKS.

workspaceId.description: The unique ID of the workspace containing the webhook. Get this from CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES.

webhooks.logs.list.title: Get Webhook Logs
webhooks.logs.list.description: Tool to retrieve webhook logs for a specific webhook. Use when you need to inspect webhook delivery history, debug failed webhook calls, or monitor webhook activity. Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_WEBHOOK_LOGS.

to.description: Represents date and time in yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. If provided, results will include logs which occurred before this value.

from.description: Represents date and time in yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. If provided, results will include logs which occurred after this value.

webhookId.description: Represents a webhook identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

sortByNewest.description: If set to true, logs will be sorted with most recent first.

workspaces.get.title: Get Workspace Info
workspaces.get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Clockify workspace. Use this tool to get workspace configuration, settings, memberships, and features. Requires a workspace ID which can be obtained from 'Get All My Workspaces' action. Returns workspace details including: - Name and ID - Cost rates and hourly rates - Subscription type and enabled features - Membership information - Workspace settings (time tracking mode, permissions, etc.) Covers CLOCKIFY_GET_WORKSPACE_INFO.

workspaceId.description: The unique identifier of the workspace to retrieve. Can be obtained from 'Get All My Workspaces' action.

assignments.list.title: List Assignments
assignments.list.description: Tool to retrieve all scheduling assignments in a workspace. Use when you need to view team member assignments to projects within a specific date range. Covers CLOCKIFY_LIST_ASSIGNMENTS.

end.description: End date for the assignment query in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-02-28T23:59:59Z'). Optional parameter to limit the date range.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Defaults to 1 if not specified.

start.description: Start date for the assignment query in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-02-01T00:00:00Z'). Required parameter to filter assignments.

page-size.description: Number of assignments to return per page. Defaults to the API default if not specified.

workspaceId.description: ID of the workspace to retrieve assignments from. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES to get workspace IDs.

user_groups.users.remove.title: Remove User From Group
user_groups.users.remove.description: Tool to remove a user from a group in Clockify. Returns the updated user group details after removal. Covers CLOCKIFY_REMOVE_USER_FROM_GROUP.

userId.description: Represents a user identifier across the system.

userGroupId.description: Represents a user group identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

time_entries.stop.title: Stop User Timer
time_entries.stop.description: Tool to stop a currently running timer for a user in a workspace. Use when ending an active time tracking session by providing the end timestamp. Covers CLOCKIFY_STOP_USER_TIMER.

end.description: The timestamp when the timer should stop, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-02-13T14:30:00Z').

userId.description: User identifier whose timer should be stopped.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier where the timer is running.

clients.update.title: Update Client
clients.update.description: Tool to update an existing client in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to modify client details such as name, email, address, or archived status. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_CLIENT.

id.description: Represents a client identifier across the system.

note.description: Represents additional notes for the client (0..3000 characters).

archived.description: Indicates if client will be archived or not.

currencyId.description: Represents a currency identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

archiveProjects.description: If true, archive all projects associated with this client.

markTasksAsDone.description: If true, mark all tasks associated with this client as done.

projects.update.title: Update Project
projects.update.description: Tool to update an existing project in a Clockify workspace. Use when modifying project details like name, color, billable status, or client associations. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_PROJECT.

note.description: Project note or description (up to 16384 characters).

color.description: Project color in hexadecimal RGB format (e.g., #FF0000 for red).

clientId.description: Client identifier to associate with the project.

costRate.description: Cost rate object for the project.

hourlyRate.description: Hourly rate object for the project.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier where the project exists.

projects.memberships.update.title: Update Project Memberships
projects.memberships.update.description: Tool to update project memberships in Clockify. Use when you need to add users to a project or modify their rates. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_PROJECT_MEMBERSHIPS.

projectId.description: Project identifier whose memberships will be updated. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_PROJECTS or similar to get project IDs.

userGroups.description: Filter for user groups to include or exclude in memberships.

memberships.description: List of user memberships to set for the project. Each membership requires a userId and optional hourly/cost rates.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier where the project resides. Use CLOCKIFY_GET_ALL_MY_WORKSPACES to get workspace IDs.

projects.users.hourly_rate.update.title: Update Project User Hourly Rate
projects.users.hourly_rate.update.description: Tool to update a project user's billable rate. Use when you need to set or change the hourly rate for a specific user on a project. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_PROJECT_USER_HOURLY_RATE.

since.description: Represents a date and time in yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format.

amount.description: Represents an amount as integer (in smallest currency unit, e.g., cents).

userId.description: Represents a user identifier across the system.

projectId.description: Represents a project identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

shared_reports.update.title: Update Shared Report
shared_reports.update.description: Tool to update an existing shared report in Clockify. Use when modifying report name, visibility, date settings, or filter configuration. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_SHARED_REPORT.

id.description: Identifier of the shared report to update.

filter.description: Filter configuration object containing date range settings and type-specific filters.

isPublic.description: Whether the report is publicly accessible.

fixedDate.description: Whether to use fixed dates for the report. If false, the report uses relative dates.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier where the shared report exists.

tags.update.title: Update Tag
tags.update.description: Tool to update a tag in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to rename a tag or archive/unarchive it. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_TAG.

id.description: Represents a tag identifier across the system.

archived.description: Indicates whether a tag will be archived or not.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

tasks.update.title: Update Task
tasks.update.description: Tool to update an existing task on a project in Clockify. Use when modifying task details like name, assignees, status, estimates, or billing settings. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_TASK.

taskId.description: Represents a task identifier across the system.

billable.description: Indicates whether a task is billable or not.

estimate.description: Represents a task duration estimate in ISO 8601 format (e.g., PT1H30M).

projectId.description: Represents a project identifier across the system.

assigneeId.description: Represents assignee id for the task.

assigneeIds.description: Represents list of assignee ids for the task.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

userGroupIds.description: Represents list of user group ids for the task.

budgetEstimate.description: Represents a task budget estimate as integer.

contains-assignee.description: Flag to set whether task will have assignee or none.

templates.update.title: Update Template
templates.update.description: Tool to update a template in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to modify a template's name. Note: This endpoint is deprecated in API v1. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_TEMPLATE.

templateId.description: Represents a template identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

time_entries.bulk_update.title: Update Time Entries
time_entries.bulk_update.description: Tool to bulk update multiple time entries in a Clockify workspace. Use when modifying multiple time logs simultaneously with start/end times, descriptions, billable status, or project/task associations. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_TIME_ENTRIES.

userId.description: User identifier who owns the time entries.

hydrated.description: If set to true, results will contain additional information about the time entries.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier containing the time entries.

time_entries.description: List of time entries to update (minimum 1 entry required).

time_entries.update.title: Update Time Entry
time_entries.update.description: Tool to update an existing time entry in a Clockify workspace. Use when modifying time logs including start/end times, description, billable status, or project/task associations. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_TIME_ENTRY.

end.description: End time in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ). If omitted, timer will be running.

start.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ). This is required.

tagIds.description: List of tag IDs to associate with this time entry.

taskId.description: ID of the task this time entry is associated with.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

projectId.description: ID of the project this time entry belongs to.

description.description: Description of the work done (0-3000 characters).

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier containing the time entry.

customFields.description: List of custom field values for this time entry (max 50 items).

user_groups.update.title: Update User Group
user_groups.update.description: Tool to update an existing user group in a workspace. Use when you need to modify the name of a user group. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_USER_GROUP.

id.description: Represents a user group identifier across the system.

name.description: Represents a user group name (0..100 characters).

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

users.hourly_rate.update.title: Update User Hourly Rate
users.hourly_rate.update.description: Tool to update a user's hourly rate in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to set or change the billable hourly rate for a specific user. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_USER_HOURLY_RATE.

since.description: Represents a date and time in yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format.

amount.description: Represents an hourly rate amount as integer (in smallest currency unit, e.g., cents).

userId.description: Represents a user identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.

webhooks.update.title: Update Webhook
webhooks.update.description: Tool to update a webhook in a workspace. Use when you need to modify an existing webhook's configuration such as its name, URL, event type, or trigger sources. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_WEBHOOK.

webhookId.description: Represents webhook identifier across the system.

workspaceId.description: Represents workspace identifier across the system.

triggerSource.description: Represents a list of trigger sources.

workspaces.hourly_rate.update.title: Update Workspace Hourly Rate
workspaces.hourly_rate.update.description: Tool to update the workspace billable hourly rate. Use when you need to set or modify the default hourly billing rate for a workspace. Covers CLOCKIFY_UPDATE_WORKSPACE_HOURLY_RATE.

since.description: Represents a date and time in yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. When provided, the rate applies from this date onwards.

amount.description: Represents an amount as integer in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). Must be non-negative.

currency.description: Represents a currency code (e.g., USD, EUR).

workspaceId.description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.
